rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Optionally measure up to four rooms instead of the single temperature sensor. Each room averages its temperature sensors that reported within the report gap limit. If any room with an occupancy sensor is occupied, only occupied rooms are used; otherwise all rooms with a recent temperature are averaged. Changes of the active rooms blend over 15 minutes and are excluded from learning. Leave every slot empty to keep the single sensor. Changing only rooms applies immediately without stopping heating.

schedule.title: Heating schedule
schedule.description: Enter one slot per line as `HH:MM temperature [all|weekday|weekend]` (e.g. `06:00 20 weekday`, `21:00 25`). Days default to all. Temperatures 18-30 °C, up to 12 slots. While the HOME preset is active and the schedule switch is on, the target changes at each slot time; a manually set target is kept until the next slot. AUTO starts heating up to 120 minutes before a raising slot when learning evidence is sufficient. Changing only the schedule applies immediately without stopping heating.
